tp:taxonomyPackage.tp:name: The annual 2026 SEC Reporting Taxonomy (SRT)
tp:taxonomyPackage.tp:description: The 2026 SEC Reporting Taxonomy (SRT) includes elements to meet U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) requirements for financial schedules required by the SEC, condensed consolidating financial information for guarantors, and disclosures about oil and gas producing activities. The SRT also includes dimensional elements whose underlying recognition and measurement are not specified by GAAP. The SRT is intended to be used with other taxonomies that meet SEC requirements.

tp:entryPoint.tp:name: All SEC Reporting Taxonomy (SRT) components and five related SEC Taxonomies - DEI, COUNTRY, CURRENCY
tp:entryPoint.tp:description: This entry point includes ALL components for the SEC Reporting Taxonomy (SRT). Five related SEC Taxonomies are also imported - DEI, COUNTRY, STPR, EXCH and CURRENCY.

tp:entryPoint.tp:name: All SEC Reporting Taxonomy (SRT) components except for doc and ref linkbases; and three related SEC Taxonomies - DEI, COUNTRY, CURRENCY
tp:entryPoint.tp:description: This entry point includes all components for the SEC Reporting Taxonomy (SRT) except for document and reference linkbases. Three related SEC Taxonomies are also imported - DEI, COUNTRY, and CURRENCY.

tp:entryPoint.tp:name: SEC Reporting Taxonomy (SRT) Elements only
tp:entryPoint.tp:description: This is the schema file (elements) for the 2026 SEC Reporting Taxonomy (SRT).

tp:entryPoint.tp:name: 2025 GAAP Financial Reporting Taxonomy Element to 2026 SEC Reporting Taxonomy (SRT) Element Mapping
tp:entryPoint.tp:description: This entry point includes a mapping from the 2025 GAAP Taxonomy to the 2026 SEC Reporting Taxonomy (SRT) via arcrole/dep-concept-deprecatedConcept.
